## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Generated `dist/` files are included when source changes affect them.
- [ ] All examples, logs and screenshots use invented data, with fixed dates in 2099.
- [ ] No real plan links, financial records, browser exports or credentials are included.

## Visual changes

For UI changes, embed paired Before/After screenshots, captured revisions and
original-size links. Match data, viewport, locale and selected state. Include
phone views for responsive changes. Otherwise explain why screenshots do not apply.
